_doc: Plain code/data patches applied by insert.py (orig bytes asserted against the source ROM). Offsets are ROM offsets.

naming_abc_default.why: The name-entry screen opened on the pinyin page (CHN), where letters only build pinyin for Chinese candidates; confirming then left the name empty and the game picked a random default name (e.g. 'Roak'). Open on the ABC page instead. Init (0x9FF505C) zeroes currentPage (struct+0x2622, sNamingScreen at 0x203998C); the keyboard draw (0x9FF5A00) loads page 0's tilemap and preloads page 1's. Select still cycles CHN -> symbols -> ABC.

patch.asm: r2=base+0x261A; strh 0,1,0 at +0x261A/C/E... (same stores as before) then 0x2620=0, page(0x2622)=2; ldr r1,=0x262C kept
patch._note: orig: ldr r2 / strh r3,[r0,r2] pairs for 0x261A..0x2622 (ldr r2,=0x261A at 0x1FF50A0 kept)
